skills.reference_body: Define final process, physical dimensions, units, viewBox, layers, colors, stroke behavior, cut or engrave intent, kerf or bleed, fonts, text conversion, image embedding, intellectual-property rights, machine or print compatibility, and acceptance tests. Preserve an editable master and a production copy. Inspect paths, overlaps, open contours, duplicates, clipping, scale, and output rendering before release.
skills.asset_body:
# SVG Production Plan

## Product, process, dimensions, units, owner, rights, and target equipment

| Element or layer | Purpose | Color or operation | Geometry check | Output status | Owner |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|

## ViewBox, scale, fonts, strokes, fills, kerf, bleed, and embedded assets

## Path, overlap, contour, duplicate, clipping, rendering, and machine tests

## Editable master, production export, approval, version, and archive
skills.recovery: If dimensions, process, artwork rights, machine interpretation, fonts, geometry, or acceptance evidence is unresolved, keep the SVG as a draft. Do not release it for irreversible cutting, engraving, or printing until a representative output is verified.

skills.reference_body: Verify exact material identity, coating, thickness, supplier safety evidence, machine, wavelength, optics, ventilation, fire controls, focus, fixture, artwork, and desired result. Never validate prohibited or unidentified materials. Use supervised test coupons and record power, speed, frequency or interval, passes, air assist, focus offset, char, depth, edge quality, residue, flame behavior, and cleanup.
skills.asset_body:

## Material, coating, thickness, supplier evidence, machine, optics, and safety controls

| Test ID | Power | Speed | Passes | Focus | Air assist | Result |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|

## Desired depth or mark, fixture, ventilation, fire watch, residue, and cleanup

## Edge, contrast, char, flame, repeatability, dimensional, and finish checks

## Validated range, exclusions, operator approval, profile version, and review date
skills.recovery: If material identity, safety evidence, machine state, ventilation, fire protection, or test-coupon results are unresolved, do not process the production piece. Quarantine the proposed settings and escalate to an authorized operator.
skills.recovery_scenario: Laser material or safety evidence is incomplete.

skills.reference_body: Review against the approved model version, intended use, orientation, printer, material batch, profile, dimensions, tolerances, surface criteria, mechanical expectations, and sampling plan. Inspect warping, layer adhesion, extrusion, seams, supports, holes, mating features, finish, contamination, and post-processing. Measure with calibrated tools where required and separate cosmetic acceptance from functional or safety validation.
skills.asset_body:

## Part, model version, intended use, printer, material batch, profile, and sample

| Characteristic | Specification | Measurement | Result | Severity | Disposition |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|

## Dimensions, tolerance, warping, layers, extrusion, seams, supports, and finish

## Fit, function, post-processing, repeatability, safety limitations, and evidence

## Accept, rework, reject, root cause, approval, and retained sample
skills.recovery: If the approved model, specification, measurement method, tool calibration, intended use, or acceptance authority is unresolved, quarantine the part. Do not represent cosmetic inspection as functional or safety certification.

skills.reference_body: Create manufacturer-aligned preventive maintenance for printers, lasers, ventilation, compressors, hand tools, and related equipment. Record asset identity, manuals, hours or cycles, inspection points, cleaning, lubrication, calibration, consumables, filters, safety interlocks, electrical condition, authorized service boundaries, parts, downtime, and evidence. Lock out unsafe equipment and never bypass guards or interlocks.

|---|---|---|---|---|---|

## Cleaning, lubrication, calibration, filters, optics, ventilation, and interlocks

## Inspection findings, unsafe conditions, lockout, service, and return-to-use tests

## Schedule, inventory, downtime, approvals, history, and next due date
skills.recovery: If manufacturer guidance, service authority, safety interlock condition, ventilation, electrical state, or return-to-use evidence is unresolved, remove the equipment from service. Escalate to qualified repair rather than improvising a bypass.
skills.recovery_scenario: Equipment safety or service evidence is incomplete.

Compare like-for-like total landed cost. Verify claims and samples, protect sensitive information, and require owner approval before commitment.

skills.recovery: If specification, documentation, sample quality, total landed cost, capacity, terms, ownership, or continuity risk is unresolved, do not issue a purchase commitment. Use a controlled sample or trial order and retain comparison evidence.

skills.reference_body: Use verified order, product, policy, communication, and fulfillment evidence to prepare accurate, empathetic responses. Minimize personal data and distinguish acknowledgement, investigation, workaround, resolution, refund or replacement authority, and follow-up. Never invent shipment status, policy exceptions, product safety conclusions, or compensation. Escalate threats, injuries, reactions, privacy, fraud, chargebacks, and legal issues.

|---|---|---|---|---|---|

## Privacy, safety, allergy or reaction, fraud, legal, and chargeback indicators

skills.recovery: If identity, order facts, policy, safety impact, compensation authority, or shipment evidence is unresolved, acknowledge the issue without promising an outcome. Protect the customer record and escalate to the authorized owner.
skills.recovery_scenario: Customer case authority or evidence is incomplete.

Protect personal data and preserve chain of custody. Quarantine unsafe or contaminated goods and separate policy eligibility from discretionary exceptions.
